versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Then Job answered,
controles.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
controles.livre: Porém Jó respondeu dizendo:

versos.hebraico: עַד־אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּן נַפְשִׁ֑י וּֽתְדַכְּאוּנַ֥נִי בְמִלִּֽים׃

controles.web: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
controles.kjv: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
controles.livre: Até quando atormentareis minha alma, e me quebrantareis com palavras?

versos.hebraico: זֶ֤ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים תַּכְלִימ֑וּנִי לֹֽא־תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ־לִֽי׃

controles.web: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
controles.kjv: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
controles.livre: Já dez vezes me humilhastes; não tendes vergonha em me maltratar.

versos.hebraico: וְאַף־אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽי׃

controles.web: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
controles.kjv: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
controles.livre: Mesmo se eu tiver errado, meu erro cabe apenas a mim.

versos.hebraico: אִם־אָ֭מְנָם עָלַ֣י תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ וְתוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗י חֶרְפָּתִּֽי׃

controles.web: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach;
controles.kjv: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
controles.livre: Visto que vos exaltais contra mim, e contra mim usais minha desgraça,

versos.hebraico: דְּֽעוּ־אֵ֭פוֹ כִּי־אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑נִי וּ֝מְצוּד֗וֹ עָלַ֥י הִקִּֽיף׃

controles.web: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
controles.kjv: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
controles.livre: Sabei, pois, que foi Deus que me transtornou, e com sua rede me cercou.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְאֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
controles.kjv: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
controles.livre: Eis que eu clamo: Violência! Porém não sou respondido; grito, porém não há justiça.

versos.hebraico: אָרְחִ֣י גָ֭דַר וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְעַ֥ל נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים׃

controles.web: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
controles.kjv: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
controles.livre: Ele entrincheirou meu caminho, de modo que não consigo passar; e pôs trevas sobre minhas veredas.

versos.hebraico: כְּ֭בוֹדִי מֵעָלַ֣י הִפְשִׁ֑יט וַ֝יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
controles.kjv: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
controles.livre: Ele me despojou de minha honra, e tirou a coroa de minha cabeça.

versos.hebraico: יִתְּצֵ֣נִי סָ֭בִיב וָאֵלַ֑ךְ וַיַּסַּ֥ע כָּ֝עֵ֗ץ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃

controles.web: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. My hope he has plucked up like a tree.
controles.kjv: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
controles.livre: Ele me derrubou por todos os lados, e pereço;  e arrancou minha esperança como a uma árvore.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣י אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי ל֣וֹ כְצָרָֽיו׃

controles.web: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
controles.kjv: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
controles.livre: E fez inflamar contra mim sua ira, e me considerou para consigo como a um de seus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: יַ֤חַד׀ יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ גְדוּדָ֗יו וַיָּסֹ֣לּוּ עָלַ֣י דַּרְכָּ֑ם וַיַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְאָהֳלִֽי׃

controles.web: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
controles.kjv: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
controles.livre: Juntas vieram suas tropas; prepararam contra mim seu caminho, e se acamparam ao redor de minha tenda.

versos.hebraico: אַ֭חַי מֵעָלַ֣י הִרְחִ֑יק וְ֝יֹדְעַ֗י אַךְ־זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

controles.web: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
controles.kjv: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
controles.livre: Ele afastou meus irmãos para longe de mim; e os que me conheciam agora me estranham.

versos.hebraico: חָדְל֥וּ קְרוֹבָ֑י וּֽמְיֻדָּעַ֥י שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃

controles.web: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
controles.kjv: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
controles.livre: Meus parentes me deixaram, e meus conhecidos se esqueceram de mim.

versos.hebraico: גָּ֘רֵ֤י בֵיתִ֣י וְ֭אַמְהֹתַי לְזָ֣ר תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑נִי נָ֝כְרִ֗י הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Those who dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
controles.kjv: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
controles.livre: Os moradores de minha casa e minhas servas me tiveram por estranho; estrangeiro me tornei em seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: לְעַבְדִּ֣י קָ֭רָאתִי וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה בְּמוֹ־פִ֝֗י אֶתְחַנֶּן־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
controles.kjv: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
controles.livre: Chamei a meu servo, e ele não respondeu; de minha própria boca eu lhe suplicava.

versos.hebraico: ר֭וּחִֽי זָ֣רָה לְאִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝חַנֹּתִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽי׃

controles.web: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
controles.kjv: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.
controles.livre: Meu hálito é estranho à minha mulher, e sou repugnante aos filhos de minha mãe.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ־בִֽי׃

controles.web: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
controles.kjv: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
controles.livre: Até os meninos me desprezam; quando eu me levanto, falam contra mim.

versos.hebraico: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי כָּל־מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑י וְזֶֽה־אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ־בִֽי׃

controles.web: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
controles.kjv: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
controles.livre: Todos os meus amigos próximos me abominam; e até aqueles que eu amava se viraram contra mim.

versos.hebraico: בְּעוֹרִ֣י וּ֭בִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑י וָ֝אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗ה בְּע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽי׃

controles.web: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
controles.kjv: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
controles.livre: Meus ossos se grudaram à minha pele e à minha carne; e escapei só com a pele de meus dentes.

versos.hebraico: חָנֻּ֬נִי חָנֻּ֣נִי אַתֶּ֣ם רֵעָ֑י כִּ֥י יַד־אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽי׃

controles.web: “Have pity on me, have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
controles.kjv: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
controles.livre: Compadecei-vos de mim, meus amigos, compadecei-vos de mim; pois a mão de Deus me tocou.

versos.hebraico: לָ֭מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣נִי כְמוֹ־אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃

controles.web: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
controles.kjv: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
controles.livre: Por que vós me perseguis como Deus, e não vos fartais de minhas carne?

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ וְיִכָּתְב֣וּן מִלָּ֑י מִֽי־יִתֵּ֖ן בַּסֵּ֣פֶר וְיֻחָֽקוּ׃

controles.web: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
controles.kjv: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
controles.livre: Ah se minhas palavras fossem escritas! Ah se fossem escritas em um livro!

versos.hebraico: בְּעֵט־בַּרְזֶ֥ל וְעֹפָ֑רֶת לָ֝עַ֗ד בַּצּ֥וּר יֵחָצְבֽוּן׃

controles.web: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
controles.kjv: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
controles.livre: Que com ponta de ferro e com chumbo fossem esculpidas em pedra para sempre!

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִי חָ֑י וְ֝אַחֲר֗וֹן עַל־עָפָ֥ר יָקֽוּם׃

controles.web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
controles.kjv: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
controles.livre: Pois eu sei que meu Redentor vive, e ao fim se levantará sobre a terra;

versos.hebraico: וְאַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִֽי נִקְּפוּ־זֹ֑את וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י אֶֽחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃

controles.web: After my skin is destroyed, then in my flesh shall I see God,
controles.kjv: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
controles.livre: E mesmo depois de consumida minha pele, então em minha carne verei a Deus;

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִ֨י׀ אֶֽחֱזֶה־לִּ֗י וְעֵינַ֣י רָא֣וּ וְלֹא־זָ֑ר כָּל֖וּ כִלְיֹתַ֣י בְּחֵקִֽי׃

controles.web: Whom I, even I, shall see on my side. My eyes shall see, and not as a stranger.   “My heart is consumed within me.
controles.kjv: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
controles.livre: Ao qual eu verei para mim, e meus olhos o verão, e não outro. Isto é o que minhas entranhas  anseiam dentro de mim.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה־נִּרְדָּף־ל֑וֹ וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא־בִֽי׃

controles.web: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
controles.kjv: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
controles.livre: Se disserdes: Como o perseguiremos? Pois a raiz do problema se acha em mim,

versos.hebraico: גּ֤וּרוּ לָכֶ֨ם׀ מִפְּנֵי־חֶ֗רֶב כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּן שדין׃ס

controles.web: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
controles.kjv: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
controles.livre: Temei vós mesmos a espada; pois furor há nos castigos pela espada; para que assim saibais que haverá julgamento.
